text:
andrew: Heads-up — I'm assembling an ops-handbook page for on‑prem / VPC launches. Need to lock the networking & packaging launch criteria today so field has a crisp checklist.

maya: thanks. can we make the criteria two buckets: MUST and NICE-TO-HAVE? ops needs musts to signoff. :white_check_mark:

devon: agreed. from runtime side MUST: model serving on default config, graceful fallback to hosted model variant, and rolling upgrade <= 2h for infra-critical patches.

leo: network MUSTs from field: 1) customer-managed peering (BGP or static) + documented handshake steps, 2) IP preservation plan for upgrades, 3) clear troubleshooting playbook (tcpdump examples, ports).

sophie: packaging MUSTs: airgap install path (tar.gz + sha256), automated health probes, operator manifests pinned to semver tags, and an offline diagnostics bundle command.

claire: legal/compliance ask: customer audit logs retention & KMS integration must be documented. default retention 90d and option to extend.

andrew: rough checklist draft — please eyeball and flag gaps:```
MUST
- Network handshake: BGP peering doc + sample config (ASNs, communities)
- IP preservation + NAT migration plan
- Onprem operator manifests (vX.Y.Z) + rollback manifest
- Health probes + alert thresholds (3xx/5xx rates)
- Offline install artifacts + sha256
- Audit logs + KMS key wrapping instructions
- Upgrade window <= 2h (minor), staged canary for major

NICE-TO-HAVE
- Tenant-level canary routing glue for <10% traffic
- Automated IP failover helper script
- Opinionated network policy templates (firewall, NACL)
```

maya: looks good. want to add "operational owner and oncall bounce window" as a MUST — field needs to know who to call during upgrades.

leo: +1. add a required preflight step: confirm customer has BGP session established in lab env or provide packet capture proving syn/ack.

devon: also add latency SLO baseline measurement step: capture p50/p95 for 1k requests to the model in preflight. if p95 > 2s then block launch or require config change.

andrew: noted. I'll add owner tags. proposed owners: eng-runtime = devon, field-ops = leo, product = maya, legal = claire.

deploy-bot: :robot_face: New doc created in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/ONPRM-ops-handbook (draft) — please review and comment within 48h.

claire: for the audit/KMS item — add a sample KMS policy and a minimum set of events that must be exported (auth, key usage, encryption failures).

andrew: action items: 1) devon to add runtime rollback manifest + staging canary config (due EOD), 2) leo to draft peering step-by-step and packet capture checklist (tomorrow noon), 3) maya to update launch signoff template with owner/oncall, 4) claire to attach KMS policy snippet. I'll ping field customers after we land doc.

maya: nice. one more: define "blocked" vs "deferred" for launch exceptions (blocked = must resolve, deferred = allowed post-launch with mitigation and timeline).

leo: example we had last week: missing tenant canary wiring was deferred (allowed) but BGP session failures were blocked. include examples in the handbook.

andrew: perfect. i'll fold examples in and call for final review at 11am PT tomorrow. :calendar: 

sophie: i'll attach the airgap packaging checklist + a sample install command to the doc before EOD.

maya: thanks team. if no objections i'll mark this thread as the canonical launch criteria and update the roadmap ticket with the doc link. :thumbsup:

devon: no objections from eng-runtime.

leo: good from ops.

claire: ok from legal.

andrew: closing — for followups please comment on the Confluence draft.
